title: ResourceState
description: Output schema for Module 3 (Resource Observer) representing real-time Kubernetes infrastructure and application state.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this resource snapshot event.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this JSON Schema contract.

service_version.description: Version of the Platform service that observed this state.

cpu_utilization.description: Current average CPU utilization ratio across pods (e.g. 0.65 = 65%).

memory_utilization.description: Current average Memory utilization ratio across pods (e.g. 0.50 = 50%).

cpu_requested_cores.description: Total CPU cores requested across active pods.

cpu_limit_cores.description: Total CPU cores limit across active pods.

memory_requested_bytes.description: Total memory requested in bytes across active pods.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Total memory limit in bytes across active pods.

desired_pods.description: Count of desired replica pods in Deployment spec.

pending_pods.description: Count of pending pods undergoing scheduling/startup.

request_rate.description: Current incoming aggregate request rate (RPS) observed by telemetry.

p95_latency_ms.description: Current 95th percentile response latency in milliseconds.

error_rate.description: Current HTTP 5xx error rate ratio (0.0 to 1.0).

current_capacity_rps.description: Total estimated processing capacity (RPS) of the currently running pods.

estimated_required_capacity_rps.description: Estimated processing capacity (RPS) required for observed traffic.
